title: Prevalence, lead time and incremental lifetime signal of entombed numbered discs in the existing training corpus
hypothesis: On runs/RUN-A51D-corpus/all.states (5.26M positions from depth-1..4 behaviour policies with epsilon exploration, explored records excluded), computing the structural entombed-disc features defined in analyze.py and the frozen fast leaf's 18 features via leafdump.cpp: (1) at least half of complete depth-4 games end with an entombed >= 3 disc on the board; (2) the median lead time from first persistent appearance to death is at least 10 moves; (3) the held-out partial correlation of ent_count_ge3 with log1p(movesToDeath) beyond the 18 leaf features + occupancy + rise clock is at most -0.05 and the incremental held-out R^2 is at least 0.005.

data.reuseDisclosure: Reads only the existing training corpus runs/RUN-A51D-corpus/all.states (SEEDLEASE-A52 training ranges, already used by finding-08 and the capacity sweep). No seed is opened and no game is played. Labels (movesToDeath) are teacher labels from already-played futures; the split is dataset.py's whole-origin split.

metrics.primary: held-out partial correlation of ent_count_ge3 with log1p(movesToDeath) after the 18 frozen leaf features, occupancy and rise clock (whole-origin test split)
secondary: incremental held-out R^2 (18 features+occupancy vs +entombed), overall and depth-4-only
fraction of complete depth-3/4 games with an entombed >= 3 disc at death
lead-time distribution (median, quartiles, fraction >= 10 and >= 20 moves)
prevalence by moves-to-death bucket and by occupancy band (occupancy-matched mean lifetime with vs without)
metrics.uncertaintyMethod: held-out evaluation on the whole-origin test split; no bootstrap (diagnostic)

passCriteria: analysis completes on all non-explored records with finite leaf values (analysis.json written with records, prevalence, leadTime, incrementalSignal)
supported-as-tested if ALL of: depth-4 fracAtDeath >= 0.5; depth-4 lead-time median >= 10 moves; held-out partial correlation of ent_count_ge3 <= -0.05 AND incremental held-out R^2 >= 0.005
not-supported-as-tested if ANY of: fracAtDeath < 0.5; lead-time median < 5; partial correlation > -0.02 or incremental R^2 < 0.005
gate.failureAction: Record valid + fail; the feature is not the missing foresight term and no leaf experiment is registered on it.
gate.passAction: Record valid + pass; register a gameplay experiment adding the feature as a 19th weighted-leaf coordinate (bit-exact at weight 0) with a paired d4s5 SCREEN, and note the trigger as a candidate for a gated survival mode.

stopConditions: Stop on any rules, information-boundary, legality, determinism, or parity failure.
Stop at 1,800 wall-seconds or if the dump reports invalid records above 1% of the corpus.
